# Summit Tech

> AI software for dental practices that runs on top of OpenDental, does the
> clinical notes, front desk work and insurance claims a team would otherwise
> do by hand, and writes the results back into the chart. OpenDental stays the
> system of record.

Summit Tech is a product of SUMMIT TECH LLC, based in Salt Lake City, Utah.
It is sold to individual dental practices and to the groups and DSOs that
run several locations.

This file exists because the site is a client-rendered single-page app: a
crawler that does not execute JavaScript sees an empty document at every URL.
Everything below is a plain-text restatement of what those pages say, so it
has to be corrected whenever the pages themselves change.

## What it does

Summit Tech is a layer over the practice management system an office already
runs on, not a replacement for it. It reads the chart, does work against it,
and writes the result back. The product covers 26 modules in four groups:

- Clinical: AI Notes, Perio Chart, Treatment Plans, Clinical Decision Support,
  Patients, Patient Scores
- Front desk: Smart Scheduling, Recall, Patient Forms, Communications,
  Follow-Ups, Referrals, Treatment Follow-Up
- Billing: Insurance, Claim Reviewer, Billing, Payment Plans, Fee Optimizer,
  Patient Retention
- Operations: Dashboard, Morning Huddle, Reports, Inventory, Procurement
  Intelligence, Compliance Autopilot, Settings

Named mechanisms: SOAP note generation, a signed attestation trail, two-way
OpenDental writeback, churn scoring, PPO analytics, write-off recapture, a
jurisdiction-aware regulatory checklist, and sterilizer logs.

## Integrations

OpenDental is the only practice management system Summit Tech currently
claims support for. Other systems are handled as custom work rather than as
shipped integrations.

## Compliance

Compliance Autopilot tracks HIPAA, OSHA and state-law obligations, dated and
filed. The website targets WCAG 2.1 Level AA; the accessibility statement
lists what has been tested and what is known not to conform yet.

## Common questions

**What if it doesn't do something we need?**
Then Summit Tech builds that part. Writing custom software for groups is a
large part of what the company does — the software should fit how the office
already runs, not the other way around.

**What does it cost?**
Pricing is not published. It depends on the number of providers, the number
of locations, and how much of the product is rolled out. Numbers are worked
through on a call once the scope is known, rather than shown as a table that
turns out to be wrong.

**How does it start?**
Look at the demo first — it needs no signup and nothing to install. Then
describe how the office actually works, and Summit Tech shows what maps to
existing modules and what would be built.

**Who is it for?**
Individual dental practices, and multi-location groups and DSOs. For groups
it covers custom builds, working with the system already in use, rollout
across locations, and roll-up reporting for the organization.
